summary: Shared payload planner for local + remote (#620): bootstrap uses list_payload_relative_paths; copy_template_payload_local alias for agents; same manifest paths for import-payload and bootstrap Contents API copy.
migration_impact: No behavior change for remote bootstrap. New public alias copy_template_payload_local for local FS apply (same as import_payload). Agents should use gh plate import-payload or the alias instead of hand-crafted cp.
migration_guidance: 1. Prefer gh plate import-payload --dry-run then --apply for local adoption.
2. Code callers may use copy_template_payload_local(dest, dry_run=...) from plate_core.import_payload.
3. Bootstrap remote path still uses GitHub Contents API with the shared path list.
agent_notes: After local apply, run gh plate bootstrap --apply for labels/wiki/.plate only. Do not hand-write selective cp from package payload.
